summary: The focused v5.7.1 tests pass, but the retained RC5 evidence is bound to commit 35396b0e42f9d1afb9a2991c41bf31330a4c89aa rather than the reviewed commit. The repository also has a dirty working tree, so production behavior cannot be reproduced from the reviewed commit alone.

evidence: Command: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q tests/test_saturn_v571_dual_head.py tests/test_saturn_v571_body_width.py tests/test_saturn_v571_audit_blockers.py tests/test_tuner_v57.py
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:800-829 validates checkpoint presence, SHA-256 format, file digest, and cached-probability checkpoint identity.
production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:25-27 specifies the dual-head checkpoint and SHA-256.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:11393-11411 resolves stack calibration before measurement and supports required Leica metadata.
audits/evidence/v571_rc5_candidate/provenance/acceptance_provenance_manifest.json:10-15 and :66-71 record Leica XML calibration provenance for both specimens.

audits/evidence/v571_rc5_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json:3 records git_commit_at_generation as 35396b0e42f9d1afb9a2991c41bf31330a4c89aa, not reviewed commit 24b9ef27e9a3b602e037acc5995030cbbf496788.

audits/evidence/v571_rc5_candidate/tracking/tracking_replay_manifest.json:3 and audits/evidence/v571_rc5_candidate/end_to_end/end_to_end_visual_evidence_manifest.json:3 record the same different generation commit.
Result: modified files include sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.py, tests/test_saturn_v57_multisample.py, tests/test_saturn_v57_unet_primary.py, and tests/test_tuner_v57.py.

findings.title: RC5 evidence is not bound to the reviewed commit
findings.impact: The production-candidate claim cannot be reproduced or audited at commit 24b9ef27e9a3b602e037acc5995030cbbf496788. The required provenance validator fails before artifact validation.
evidence: scripts/validate_v571_evidence_provenance.py:48-60 compares manifest commit and pipeline/profile Git-blob identities against HEAD.
Command result: ValueError: Commit mismatch in audits\evidence\v571_rc5_candidate\stages\visual_evidence_manifest.json.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate or supersede the RC5 evidence at reviewed commit 24b9ef27e9a3b602e037acc5995030cbbf496788, then rerun the provenance validator and retain the resulting hashes.

findings.title: Working tree is dirty during acceptance review
findings.impact: The executable pipeline and tests differ from the committed repository state, so passing focused tests do not establish reproducibility of the reviewed commit.
evidence: Result lists modified sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.py and three test files.
findings.recommendation: Perform the acceptance audit from a clean checkout of commit 24b9ef27e9a3b602e037acc5995030cbbf496788 and regenerate commit-bound evidence there.

limitations: No full-stack inference was run, per audit instructions.
GUI, batch, tuner, and study entry points were inspected only through source and retained evidence; commit-bound end-to-end execution was not verified because provenance validation failed.
recommended_follow_up: Create a clean working tree at commit 24b9ef27e9a3b602e037acc5995030cbbf496788.
Regenerate all RC5 manifests and replay artifacts against that commit.
Rerun scripts/validate_v571_evidence_provenance.py and record a passing result before requesting acceptance.
